court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Inyo
case_search_note: No online case lookup described. Criminal records are requested in person or by mail with name, DOB, case number if known and documents wanted; clerk quotes the cost (send payment with a self-addressed stamped envelope). See https://www.inyo.courts.ca.gov/forms-filing/records-search-requests

sources.title: CA Dept. of Insurance — Check Agent/Broker

courthouses.name: Bishop Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Office Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–4 p.m. (closed noon–1); phone 1–4 p.m.
courthouses.note: Criminal Division page says criminal cases may be heard in Bishop or Independence but not which types go where — check the wall calendar or ask the clerk. DA (760) 878-0282; Victim Witness (760) 873-6669.

courthouses.name: Independence Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Phone 1–4 p.m.; office hours not listed for this location
courthouses.note: Departments 1 and 3 (Dept. 3 mail: P.O. Box 518; ADA access at north entry on Center Street; Dept. 1 help at the Dept. 3 counter). Criminal cases may be heard here or in Bishop.

public_defenders.name: Court-appointed counsel (Inyo County contract public defender)
public_defenders.note: Court's Criminal page: fill out a public defender application at your first appearance; the court may appoint the Public Defender, Conflict Counsel, Alternate Conflict Counsel or a private attorney. Inyo County site indicates the public defender function is contracted and administered by the County Administrator's Office.
public_defenders.todo: No public contact for the contract public defender found on an official page

probation.name: Inyo County Probation — Adult Division
probation.note: Fax (760) 872-0931. Adult Division handles probation/PRCS/mandatory supervision, presentence reports, pretrial services, alternative sentencing, victim restitution, and lists adult record expungement information.

programs.name: Pretrial Services (Inyo County Probation)
programs.summary: Probation provides pretrial risk assessments for the court and supervises people the court orders to pretrial supervision.

programs.name: Alternative Sentencing (Electronic Monitoring, Remote Alcohol Monitoring, Adult Community Service)
programs.summary: Probation-run alternatives to serving time in custody, as ordered by the court.

jails.name: Inyo County Jail
jails.phone_note: Staffed 24/7. Fax (760) 878-0404. The jail does not take incoming calls for inmates. Court says call this number to check whether someone is in custody.
jails.note: Only correctional facility in Inyo County. Visits Sat & Sun 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; call 8 a.m.–2 p.m. the same day to reserve. Money orders accepted for inmates (no cash, personal checks or cards); items via commissary only. Mail: PO Drawer 456, Independence, CA 93526. court_ids: Independence is nearest; criminal cases are also heard in Bishop — transport not confirmed.
jails.todo: Men/women housing not stated; no online deposit vendor listed

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' (linked from insurance.ca.gov CheckAgntBrkr page) — look up any bail agent's license status. Inyo jail page gives no bail procedure; call the jail at (760) 878-0370. Note: inmate_lookup_url is the Sheriff's Citizen RIMS bulletins page — not confirmed to be an in-custody roster.
